name: Manoj Ceramic Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Manoj Ceramic Limited trades in ceramic tiles and tile adhesives under the brand name "MCPL".[1]
keyPoints:
Business Division[1] 
Ceramic tiles: Co. provides tiles through its dealer network, retail showrooms, export, and B2B sales to architects, builders, and contractors. The company gets tiles manufactured by a third-party manufacturer.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.05 times its book value
Promoter holding has increased by 4.92% over last quarter.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 163 days.
